2126355740646392012.en_summary: $SPCX / $ASTS: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr says "it's a good time to invest across the board" in wireless and satellite businesses as SpaceX moves in. Asked on CNBC about SpaceX's pending EchoStar spectrum deal, Carr pointed to its direct-to-device service, "where you can go straight from your smartphone right to a low-Earth orbit satellite that eliminates dead zones." He said it's an open question whether SpaceX will complement the big three carriers or compete head to head. "The market will decide that. Consumers will."
2126355740646392012.zh_summary: $SPCX / $ASTS：FCC 主席 Brendan Carr 表示，隨著 SpaceX 進入，無線和衛星業務「現在是全面投資的好時機」。在 CNBC 被問及 SpaceX 待批的 EchoStar 頻譜交易時，Carr 指向其直接到設備服務，「你可以從智能手機直接連接到低地球軌道衛星，消除死區」。他說 SpaceX 是補充三大運營商還是正面競爭是開放問題。「市場會決定。消費者會。」
